name: Kaia yield aggregator (partial snapshot)
description: Kaia-side vault stack of a yield aggregator: CooldownVault (two-step-withdrawal wrapper of the underlying, 1:1 shares, strategy predeposit debt) feeding a Yearn V2 vault whose CustomYearnStrategy deposits the underlying into CustomVault (ERC-4626), which allocates to registered CustomStrategy contracts. Partial snapshot (the local yield path only) pinned to a fixed commit; the Yearn V2 vault (Vyper), the router, health checks, external-assets providers and execution targets are outside the analysed scope.

instances.label: CooldownVault
instances.description: User-entry vault: wraps the underlying 1:1 into cooldown shares; withdrawals are two-step (request, then claim after the cooldown).

instances.label: CustomYearnStrategy
instances.description: Yearn V2 strategy whose want is the CooldownVault share; invests the underlying in CustomVault.

instances.label: CustomVault
instances.description: ERC-4626 vault used only by CustomYearnStrategy; operators allocate its underlying to registered custom strategies.

instances.label: CustomStrategy
instances.description: Reference ICustomStrategy registered in CustomVault; its strategist executes allow-listed calls with the funds.

bindings.note: BaseCooldownStrategy sets cooldownVault = want = vault.token(); the deployed Yearn vault's token is the CooldownVault.
BaseStrategy._initialize sets want = vault.token(); the deployed Yearn vault's token is the CooldownVault.
BaseCooldownStrategy(_vault, _customVault, ...): the external share token is the CustomVault share.

external.label: Yearn V2 vault (Kaia)
external.description: Yearn V2 vault (Vyper) whose token is the CooldownVault share; not part of the repository.

bindings.note: On Kaia the custom strategy's remoteVault is the CustomVault (checked by CustomVault.addCustomStrategy).

registries.note: addCustomStrategy(customStrategy) pushes it to the array summed by totalAssets().
addAuthorizedAddress for the router, the Yearn vault and the strategies; only the strategy is analysed.

identities.note: Constructors: CustomYearnStrategy passes CustomVault(_customVault).asset() as the external underlying and BaseCooldownStrategy requires it to equal cooldownVault.asset().

assets.label: cooldown share
assets.description: ERC-20 share implemented by CooldownVault (1:1 with the underlying); transfers only between authorized addresses.

assets.label: underlying (USDT)
assets.description: Token wrapped by the CooldownVault (USDT on Kaia).

notes: Only the four analysed contracts and their transitive imports are part of the snapshot (BUSL-1.1 / GPL-3.0 sources; recreate with scripts/fetch_snapshot.py).
The Yearn V2 vault is Vyper and not in the repository: its share token, report() accounting and user deposits are outside the analysed scope.
